# Open Knowledge Format Guide
> An unofficial English guide to Open Knowledge Format, with OKF examples, templates, a browser-only validator, and comparisons with MCP, RAG, and llms.txt.

This site helps developers, AI agent builders, SEO teams, and documentation teams package knowledge as Markdown files with YAML frontmatter.

## Core content
- [Home](https://openknowledgeformat.online/): Home resource.
- [What is OKF](https://openknowledgeformat.online/what-is-okf/): What is OKF resource.
- [OKF Tutorial](https://openknowledgeformat.online/okf-tutorial/): OKF Tutorial resource.
- [OKF Examples](https://openknowledgeformat.online/okf-examples/): OKF Examples resource.
- [OKF Templates](https://openknowledgeformat.online/okf-templates/): OKF Templates resource.
- [OKF Validator](https://openknowledgeformat.online/okf-validator/): OKF Validator resource.
- [OKF vs MCP](https://openknowledgeformat.online/compare/okf-vs-mcp/): OKF vs MCP resource.
- [OKF vs RAG](https://openknowledgeformat.online/compare/okf-vs-rag/): OKF vs RAG resource.
- [OKF vs llms.txt](https://openknowledgeformat.online/compare/okf-vs-llms-txt/): OKF vs llms.txt resource.
- [About](https://openknowledgeformat.online/about/): About resource.
- [Contact](https://openknowledgeformat.online/contact/): Contact resource.

## Common resources
- [Contact](https://openknowledgeformat.online/contact/): Corrections and feedback.
- [Privacy](https://openknowledgeformat.online/privacy/): Validator privacy notes.
- [Terms](https://openknowledgeformat.online/terms/): Terms of use.

## Status
This is an unofficial guide to Open Knowledge Format. It is not affiliated with Google.
